project_type: Next.js 16 full-stack app with Mongoose/MongoDB, NextAuth, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS
build_system: Next.js (next build). Scripts run via tsx. No workspace monorepo — single package.json.
test_framework: None configured. Verification is TypeScript type-check only.
verification_instructions: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in c:\Users\HP\Desktop\Myprojects\choicepro and confirm exit code 0 with no errors. For seed scripts run `npx tsx scripts/<script-name>.ts` and confirm printed output shows created/skipped counts.
environment_constraints: Windows (win32/bash). DATABASE_URL must be set in .env for seed scripts. Do NOT restart dev server. All file paths must be absolute or relative to workspace root c:\Users\HP\Desktop\Myprojects\choicepro.
contribution_requirements: Match existing code style: named exports for utilities, default exports for models and pages, useToast from @/hooks/use-toast in admin pages, sonner toast in dashboard pages. Always check for existing result before creating in POST routes.
key_patterns: Models: mongoose Schema + interface extending Document + mongoose.models.X || mongoose.model pattern. API routes: getServerSession(authOptions) for auth, dbConnect() before DB ops, z.object Zod schema for POST body validation, NextResponse.json returns. Seed scripts: mongoose.connect(process.env.DATABASE_URL!), dotenv.config(), findOne check before create (skip if exists). Admin pages: checkAuthorization() calls /api/admin/check-super-admin, sets authorized state, then fetchData(). Auth helper: canModifyAcademicData() checks SENIOR_ADMIN or above — for course POST we bypass this and check session.user.role === 'ADMIN' directly.
directory_structure: app/ — Next.js App Router pages and API routes. app/admin/ — admin-only pages (faculties, departments, courses). app/dashboard/ — student dashboard pages (analytics, results). app/api/ — API route handlers. models/ — Mongoose model definitions. lib/ — shared utilities, auth config, DB connection. scripts/ — standalone TSX scripts for seeding/admin tasks. components/ — shared React components. hooks/ — custom React hooks.
